en-US.author: Noderr Protocol
en-US.description: Turn your Windows PC into a Noderr micronode and earn NODR tokens.
en-US.longDescription: The Noderr Micronode is the entry tier of the Noderr Protocol. Run it on your Windows PC to contribute overhead compute to the AI agent mesh network, build on-chain TrustFingerprint reputation, and earn NODR tokens as the network routes work to you. No minimum stake and no special hardware are required. The node runs quietly in the system tray, and your wallet key never leaves your PC.
en-US.name: Noderr Micronode

zh-CN.description: 将 Windows PC 变成 Noderr 微节点，赚取 NODR 代币。
zh-CN.longDescription: Noderr 微节点是 Noderr 协议的入门层级。在 Windows PC 上运行微节点，将闲置算力贡献给 AI 智能体网格网络，积累链上 TrustFingerprint 信誉，并在网络向您分配任务时赚取 NODR 代币。无需最低质押，也不需要特殊硬件。节点在系统托盘中静默运行，钱包私钥绝不会离开您的 PC。
